items.source:
Create a new URIEditor, using the given ClassLoader to resolve
"classpath:" locations into physical resource URLs.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 URIEditor，使用给定的 ClassLoader 将 "classpath:" 位置解析为物理资源 URL。

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to use for resolving "classpath:" locations (may be null to indicate the default ClassLoader)
items.translation: classLoader - 用于解析"classpath:"位置的类加载器（可为null以表示默认类加载器）

items.source: encode - indicates whether Strings will be encoded or not
items.translation: encode - 指示是否对字符串进行编码

items.source: By default, this editor will encode Strings into URIs. For instance, a space will be encoded into %20. This behavior can be changed by calling the URIEditor(boolean) constructor.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此编辑器会将字符串编码为 URI。例如，空格将被编码为%20。可以通过调用URIEditor(boolean)构造函数来更改此行为。

items.source:
Supports Spring-style URI notation: any fully qualified standard URI
("file:", "http:", etc) and Spring's special "classpath:" pseudo-URL,
which will be resolved to a corresponding URI.
items.translation: 支持 Spring 风格的 URI 表示法：任何完全限定的标准 URI（如"file:"、"http:"等）以及 Spring 专用的"classpath:"伪 URL，该伪 URL 将被解析为相应的 URI。

items.source:
Note: A URI is more relaxed than a URL in that it does not require
a valid protocol to be specified. Any scheme within a valid URI syntax
is allowed, even without a matching protocol handler being registered.
items.translation: 注意：URI 比 URL 更宽松，因为它不要求指定有效的协议。任何符合有效 URI 语法的方案都是允许的，即使没有注册匹配的协议处理器。

items.source: The default implementation encodes the value into an RFC-2396 compliant URI.
items.translation: 默认实现将值编码为符合 RFC-2396 标准的 URI。

items.source:
Create a new, encoding URIEditor, converting "classpath:" locations into
standard URIs (not trying to resolve them into physical resources).
items.translation: 创建一个新的编码 URIEditor，将"classpath:"位置转换为标准 URI（不尝试将其解析为物理资源）。

items.source:

items.source: URISyntaxException - if URI conversion failed
items.translation: URISyntaxException - 如果 URI 转换失败

items.source: value - the value to convert into a URI instance
items.translation: value - 要转换为 URI 实例的值

items.source: Create a URI instance for the given user-specified String value.
items.translation: 为给定的用户指定字符串值创建 URI 实例。
